newsitem.title: USA: Circuit City names McCollough president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Circuit City names McCollough president, COO.

text.p: Circuit City Stores Inc named 10-year Circuit City veteran W. Alan McCollough as president and chief operating officer, the company said Monday.
Richard L. Sharp retains the title of chairman and chief executive officer with responsibility for both the Circuit City and CarMax businesses.

McCollough was most recently the company's senior vice president of merchandising. From 1991 to 1995, he was president of Circuit City's central operating division, with direct responsibility for more than a third of the company's stores.
Circuit City Stores, Inc. is the nation's largest retailer of brand-name consumer electronics and major appliances and a leading retailer of personal computers and music software.
